test_title: PYST 67: SSC GD Constable 2022 - English (Held On : 08 Feb 2023 Shift 3)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate antonym of the bracketed word.**

Due to some technical emergency, the helicopter was supposed to land on a _______ (occupied) piece of land.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Vacant**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate option to fill in the blank is "**vacant**."
 
• The word "**occupied**" means that the land is already in use or taken by someone or something. (पहले से ही उपयोग में है या किसी व्यक्ति या वस्तु द्वारा लिया गया है)
 
 
• **Example**: *The parking lot is fully occupied; we might need to find another spot.*
 
 
 
• Marked option "**vacant**" means that the land is empty or unoccupied. (ख़ाली)
 
 
• **Example**: *The house next door has been vacant for months; no one has moved in.*
 
 
 
• In the context of the sentence, "**landing on vacant land**" is more suitable during a technical emergency, as it implies that there are no obstructions or potential dangers on the landing site.
 
• The **corrected sentence** would be: *Due to some technical emergency, the helicopter was supposed to land on a vacant __piece of land.*

Thus, **option 3** is the correct answer.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• **Jammed: **Blocked or stuck due to overcrowding or a physical obstruction. (भीड़भाड़ या शारीरिक रुकावट के कारण अवरुद्ध या अटका हुआ)
 
• **Active: **Engaged in action or characterized by movement or energy. (क्रिया में संलग्न या गति या ऊर्जा से युक्त)
 
• **Teeming: **Abundantly filled or swarming with a large number of things or people. (बहुत सारी चीजों या लोगों से प्रचुर मात्रा में भरा हुआ या झुंड में भरा हुआ)
